No. 2154/58 – SATURDAY, DECEMBER 21, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 07
Ministry of Lands and Land Development Reference
Number : 4-3/2/2016/A/402. Divisional Secretary's Number:
BD/HD/LND/03/01/P .O. Q.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lans which is required for the purpose of acquiring land for the official residence of a Project Officer of the Department of Export Agriculture.
Description of the Land to be Acquired:

The allotments of lands situated in the Grama Niladhari Divisions of Ranasinghagama (155-H) Village of Ranasinghagama in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Haldummulla, Badulla District in Uva Province depicted in Plan No. 729, and dated 27.08.2019 prepared by the Surveyor-General, containing in extent 0.2000 Hectare and described as follows :
01. Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Lemaswaththa (Pettigala Part); Description: The wasteland; Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.0330 Hectare.

Boundaries of the Land : North: Kandura, Pettigala Estate claimed by Land Reform Commission and Lot No. 02; East: Pettigala Estate claimed by Land Reform Commission, Lot Nos. 2 and 4; South: Lots 2, 4 and kandura; West : Kandura.

02. Lot No. 2 Name of the land: Lemaswaththa (Pettigala Division); Description: Garden, 20-30 years old mixed Cultivation & Permanent Building; Claimant: Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.1288 Hectare.

Boundaries of the Land : North: Lot No. 4 and Pettigala Estate claimed by Land Reform Commission; East: Pettigala Estate claimed by Land Reform Commission and Lot Nos. 3 and 4; South: Lots 3, 4 and 1; West: Lot No. 01

03. Lot No. 3 Name of the land: Lemaswaththa (Pettigala Division); Description: Waste Land; Claimant : Land Reform Commission; Extent: 0.0071 Hectare.

Boundaries of the Land : North: Lot No. 02, Pettigala Watta and Road (Pradeshiya Saba) claimed by Land Reforms Commission; East: Pettigala Estate claimed by Land Reforms Commission, Road (Pradeshiya Saba) and Lot No. 04; South : Road (Divisional Secretariat Councils) Lots 4 and 2; West: Lot 2

Boundaries of the Land : North: Lots No. 1, 2, 3 and Road (Pradeshiya Saba); East: Road (Pradeshiya Saba) and Road (Road Development Authority); South: Road (Road Development Authority) and Kandura; West: Kandura, Lot Nos. 1, 2 and 3.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Haldummulla on the 10th February, 2020 at 10.00 a.m., and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd day of February, 2020, the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
V. P. SUNETH JINENDRASENA, Divisional Secretary, Haldummulla.
Divisional Secretary's Office, Haldummulla, 16th December, 2019. 01 - 279

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 07
My Reference No.: BD/WM/LND/2/5/AQUIS/16.
Land Ministry Ref. No. : 4-3/9/2016/WS/45.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 07 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, The Government intends to acquire the following land which are for a public purpose.
Description of the land to be Acquired:

In the Province of Uva, District of Badulla, Divisional Secretariat of Welimada in the Minor Division of Dambawini Palatha Korale, Village of Guruthalawa, Surveyor General F. V. P. 189, Paper No. 30 of supplement 20 and dated on 24.08.2018 base plot Lot number 621 the total extent of 0.0324 hectare the details follow :

1. Lot No. 621 Name of the Land : Gonagolla; Description : Home Garden, Water Tank and Permanent building; Claimant : The Government and S. Badurdeen, holding permit No. 189/252; Extent : 0.0324 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat Office, Welimada on the day and time relevant to each land lots as writing (in duplicate) on or before the 27th day of January, 2020 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Date Time Lot Number 2020.01.27 10.00 a.m. 621
W. M. C. WEERASINGHE, Divisional Secretary, Welimada.
Divisional Secretary's Office, Welimada, 19th December, 2019. 01 - 280
